facts.fact: 想要他 vs 容纳他的全部——两件不同的事。
facts.anchor: But wanting Gunnar and accommodating all of Gunnar were two very different things.

facts.fact: 他不动的确定性，比任何耳语安慰更能让她放松。
facts.anchor: That certainty did more to relax me than any whispered reassurance could have.
He was holding himself back. For me.

facts.fact: 反转：他追、他抓、他压——现在他让她主导。
facts.anchor: And now he was letting me lead.
No one had ever trusted me like this.

facts.fact: 她的占有宣言：谁敢拆他们，她会毫不犹豫干掉对方。
facts.anchor: if any pack, any Alpha, or my own mother tried to take him from me, I would end them without hesitation.

facts.fact: 她在他身上宣示：你是我的，谁敢夺走我就杀谁。
章末：这一次她不是猎物——她把猎手弄跪了。
facts.anchor: For once, I wasn't the prey. I'd brought the predator to his knees.
